items.title: Tesla’s Cybertruck Price Increase Shows  Cost Trumps Demand
items.summary: The dual-motor all-wheel drive version now starts at about $75,000, up from $70,000, according to Tesla’s website.  Tesla, like other auto makers, is facing higher costs for everything from copper to memory chips.  Price increases help offset cost inflation.
